name: @guidobuilds/loopback
description: Harness-agnostic feedback loop for AI coding agents (Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex): the portable `feedback-detector` skill, the `/harness-feedback` command, and the Claude Code plugin whose priming hooks let the detector name the real harness component a user is correcting. The MCP server is hosted by the loopback service (remote MCP); clients are wired up via `npx @guidobuilds/loopback-setup`.
author: Guido Caffa <caffaguido@gmail.com>
